proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Production of an Annual Report on Certain Trade Association and Lobbying Expenditures
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report disclosing BlackRock's direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, trade association memberships and decision-making oversight for such payments.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Simple Majority Vote Requirement
proposals.topic_summary: Requests elimination of charter and bylaw voting requirements greater than a simple majority, replacing them with a majority of votes cast or simple majority standard.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this proposal.
